consent.title: Before we begin
consent.body: MindMate is a wellness companion, not a clinician. It never diagnoses or gives medical advice. You can export or delete your data anytime.

chat.title: Chat
chat.disclaimer: Reflections are offered as questions, and you can always say they're wrong.
